review.title: Eight preserved community records: scoped species-reference GTDB diagnostic
review.independence_basis: Parent and a separate peer independently read the source contexts, complete native populations and historical guard boundaries. The original ten-record plan was replaced by nine after the independent review identified record 392's conflicting manual dispositions. Parent verified the saved 347 name-fallback canary and its complete input checkpoint, then read all eight remaining exact candidate diffs and receipt pins before their serial M5 applications.
review.summary: Sixteen selected taxonomy descriptors across eight whole records receive native GTDB reference-population correspondences. Original species identities, stock names, other classifications, unresolved partners, source notes and biological claims remain unchanged. Actual guarded applications, sixteen appended inline events, eight separate native history sidecars and sixty-four scoped commands are bound. These reference populations do not establish experimental stock-genome membership.
review.scope_description: Only the sixteen selected GTDB blocks/statuses and their source, application, native-check and history provenance in eight named whole records. Full scientific assessment, reference-snippet comparison, historical successor integration and corpus QC remain separate.
review.selection: The remaining eight units of replacement plan 002: 000481, 000432, 000411, 000472, 000341, 000361, 000378 and 000408. The separately saved 000347 canary and held whole record 000392 are excluded. Each unit was applied and checked serially through the accepted engine and checker at actual M5 revision 10810fc7c1346fbceb05503e7c2485ee4edc21e3.
limitations: Partial technical and provenance assessment with scientific_review:false. Native validation does not establish complete scientific review, corpus completion or issue closure.

Source coverage is explicit per record: retained abstracts for 481, 432, 411, 341 and 408; bounded main strain/context passages as well as abstracts for 472, 361 and 378. No new figure-pixel, supplementary, stock-genome or complete-paper assessment is claimed.

Species-ID and species-name populations describe the pinned reference table, not demonstrated membership of experimental isolates. Rounded fractions do not establish exact majority numerators. The two-genome Halobacillus population is not identified with the two source stocks.

The table SHA256 binds exact bytes; no upstream GTDB release or chronology is inferred from mtime or native legacy mapping-source prose. Local NCBI file-stat observations are not a database content hash or release assertion.

Every original biological field, quote, stock, unselected classification, historical note and previous history event remains semantically unchanged. Native writer key ordering of unselected Delftia and Halobacillus marinus descriptors is not a scientific change.

The prior absence of a lung interaction graph, host placement in the rice record, nitrogen/TOC/flux distinctions, temporal fermentation limitations and incomplete source/mechanistic findings remain unresolved. The mapping corrections do not certify those existing claims.

Seven scoped validators and native history scaffolding per record are separate from reference-snippet coverage, generated products, strict historical successor admission and combined full QC. Those outcomes require their own retained evidence.

Record 392 remains wholly held under issue 2877. The original preparation 001 and its results remain historical evidence; this batch does not replace any of that record's deliberate manual dispositions with the pinned table's result.
